module_summary: 10G Ethernet MAC+PHY top that wires an AXI-Stream-to-64b/66b transmit path and a SERDES-to-AXI-Stream receive path in separate clock domains, with no glue logic.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: 64-bit AXI-Stream transmit payload into the TX MAC/PHY path.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Transmit stream valid into TX path.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: Transmit stream ready from TX path backpressure.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-enable for transmit stream words.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker for transmit stream.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: 64-bit AXI-Stream received payload from RX path.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Receive stream valid from RX path.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker for received stream.

anchors.name: serdes_tx_data
anchors.why: Scrambled 64b/66b transmit block data to SERDES.

anchors.name: serdes_tx_hdr
anchors.why: 64b/66b sync header for transmit blocks.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data
anchors.why: Received 64b/66b block data from SERDES.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Received 64b/66b sync header used for block lock.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip request to SERDES during block alignment.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: Requests SERDES receiver reset on lost lock.

anchors.name: rx_block_lock
anchors.why: Reports 64b/66b block lock achieved by RX PHY.

anchors.name: rx_status
anchors.why: Overall receive link status from RX path.

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: High bit-error-rate indication from RX PHY.

anchors.name: rx_error_count
anchors.why: PRBS/block error count output from RX path.

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Transmit underflow error from TX path.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Receive bad-frame error from RX path.

anchors.name: tx_axis_ptp_ts
anchors.why: Transmit PTP timestamp output; parameter-disabled by default.

anchors.name: tx_axis_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: Valid for transmit PTP timestamp; parameter-disabled by default.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configures inter-frame gap in TX path.

groups.name: tx_path
groups.description: Encodes AXI-Stream frames to scrambled 64b/66b SERDES blocks.

groups.name: rx_path
groups.description: Block-syncs, descrambles and decodes SERDES data into AXI-Stream frames.
